note: This is an example only. Copy one record from 'opportunities' for each new record. Delete this note in the real data file. Drafted by Samer (SAM-01) for Stefano (importer) and Hakm (display) to review.

opportunities.title: The name of the opportunity, as the provider writes it
opportunities.summary: One or two plain sentences saying what it is.

eligibility_conditions.text: The condition in plain language, as the student will read it.
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: A short summary of what the official page says. Do not copy long text.

deadline.note: Optional. For example: applications close 11:59pm AEDT.

verification.method: How it was checked. Only change the status to verified after a person has compared each condition with the page.

opportunities.data_notes: Anything unclear or conflicting. Leave this empty if there is nothing.
